rv.q: All that said, "Billy Elliot" still works and, if you've never seen the show before, you'll likely be crying by the end.
The Paramount has crafted a magnificent piece of storytelling.
The sheer grandeur of the closing moments of this production left me in awe and ranks as the most beautiful visual tapestry I have ever—repeat, ever—seen in a theatre.
This glorious show is no exception.
I was delighted and surprised to love this production of Billy Elliot so much.
I urge you to try and catch what is one of the most superb shows I’ve seen this season.
Couple that strong finish with a truly soulful and convincing performance throughout by Ron E. Rains as Billy's coal-miner dad and you've got a show well worth seeing.
This number is a hoot and the amazing choreography in this production by Isaiah Silvia-Chandley will take your breath away.

With its stellar performances, innovative direction, and timeless message of acceptance and resilience, “Billy Elliot: The Musical” is a must-see production that reaffirms the power of theater to challenge, uplift, and inspire.
